question:
Consider the following statements regarding the current Vice President of India:**
Statement 1:** Chandrapuram Ponnusami (C.P.) Radhakrishnan is the Vice President of India, took charge on 12th September 2025.**
Statement 2:** Unlike the Presidential election, the electoral college for the Vice President includes nominated members of both Houses of Parliament.**
Which of the statements above is/are correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement 2 is correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1:** Chandrapuram Ponnusami (C.P.) Radhakrishnan is not the current Vice President of India, and the date mentioned (12th September 2025) is incorrect. The current Vice President of India, as of **2023**, is **Jagdeep Dhankhar**, who assumed office on **11th August 2022**. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
 
• **Statement 2:** The electoral college for the Vice President of India includes members (both elected and nominated) of both the **Lok Sabha** and the **Rajya Sabha**, unlike the Presidential election, where nominated members are excluded. This is correct as per Article 66 of the Indian Constitution. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• The Vice Presidential election process is clearly defined in the Indian Constitution, ensuring representation from both Houses of Parliament.
 
• The Vice President serves as the **Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha** and is elected for a term of **5 years**.
